name: @pantheon-plugins/web-search
description: Web search integration — search the web using Tavily or Brave Search APIs
author: Pantheon Contributors

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the web for up-to-date information. Returns titles, URLs, and content snippets for the top results.

query.description: The search query to look up

numResults.description: Number of results to return (1-10). Default: 5

searchDepth.description: Search depth: 'basic' (fast) or 'advanced' (thorough, costs more API credits). Default: basic

TAVILY_API_KEY.description: Tavily Search API key (preferred). Get one at https://tavily.com

BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY.description: Brave Search API key (fallback). Get one at https://brave.com/search/api
